## What is a scraping MCP server?

The [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) lets an AI app call external tools. A scraping MCP server gives the agent tools like `scrape`, `crawl`, `search` or `browser_click`, so it can fetch live pages, get past blocks and return clean data inside the conversation.

- **☁️ Hosted** servers run on the vendor's infrastructure: paste a URL into your client, nothing to install.
- **🏠 Local** servers run on your machine with `npx`, `uvx`, `pip` or Docker.
- **🆓 Free** means open source and no paid account needed; **🔑** means you need an API key (most offer a free tier).

```bash
# Claude Code: add a local server
claude mcp add <name> -- npx -y <package>
# Claude Code: add a hosted server
claude mcp add --transport http <name> <endpoint-url>
```

## Browse by category

- [🛡️ Scraping APIs & Unblockers](categories/scraping-apis.md) (12) - Hosted scraping APIs that fetch pages for you and deal with blocks, CAPTCHAs and JavaScript.
- [📦 Marketplaces & Pre-built Scrapers](categories/marketplaces.md) (1) - Run ready-made scrapers for popular sites (Amazon, LinkedIn, Google Maps, TikTok…).
- [☁️ Cloud Browsers](categories/cloud-browsers.md) (5) - Remote browsers the agent can drive, with sessions, proxies and stealth handled for you.
- [🌐 Local Browser Control](categories/browser-control.md) (7) - Let the agent drive a browser on your own machine with Playwright, Selenium or Chrome DevTools.
- [🥷 Stealth & Anti-detect Browsers](categories/stealth.md) (4) - Free, self-hosted browsers and fetchers built to avoid bot detection.
- [🔎 Search & Content Extraction](categories/search-extraction.md) (7) - Web search, URL-to-markdown readers and structured extraction.
- [🕸️ Self-hosted Crawlers](categories/self-hosted.md) (4) - Open-source crawlers you run yourself, no API key needed.

## How the ranking works

Each server gets a score from 0 to 100: **85% GitHub stars** (log-scaled) and **15% recent activity** (commits in the last 90 days). Stars of a bigger project that only includes an MCP server count for a quarter, and archived repos are halved. Closed-source servers have no stars, so they rank by activity only and are listed for completeness. Inclusion is editorial; ranking is automatic and identical for every vendor. Details: [METHODOLOGY.md](METHODOLOGY.md).
